text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: I propose... a challenge.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Yes! We talked it over, and I'm all for
the idea as
well.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Our last joint training session proved
fruitful for
all of us, did it not?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I think that if we continue finding ways
to
challenge each other, then it can only
lead to
more growth.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: Yeah. So please... If you would.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They didn't have any particular criteria
in mind
for our little showdown, so I get
to pick.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
Speed... Time to become the wind.
Whoosh!

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
Stamina... I'm gonna run a lot. A whole
lot.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
Power... You know, I've really bulked up
recently.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
Guts... I can do this... With Trainer's
cheers to
keep me going.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
Wit... I'll show you just how many brain
cells I can
fire at once.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
Energy... Yeah, I think I've got plenty of
it.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: Defeat... Oof.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, Meek. I saw you give it your
all out
there, and I even got plenty of
data out of it.
Let's work on it tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for training with us! We'll be
looking
forward to the next opportunity!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
<chrname> is beaming after
her win.
Let's aim for victory next time
too!

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: Nghhh... I'm sorry, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Oh Meek, please don't worry about it. It
was me
who was underprepared for this
session. Next
time, for sure!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for training with us! Until next
time,
then.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before Happy Meek dashes off, I sense a
certain
fire in her eyes. One very much
the same as that I
can see in Trainer
Kiryuin's.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
<chrname> is just as
motivated as
ever after her successive
victory. We immediately
begin to
prepare for our next face-off.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: I won. Yippee. Thank you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
It was all you, Meek! Let's stop by your
favorite
bakery on the way back today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Happy Meek made for some tough
competition.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't help but notice
<chrname>'s
shoulders slump
in disappointment.
